propositions: Canonical preview/sync routes must emit only 0/1/2 exit codes; benign states map to 0, operational failures to 1, and invalid invocation/configuration to 2.
Legacy reconcile CLI and direct-engine adapter routes must translate the same typed disposition to historical 3/4/75 exit codes while preserving original message formatting and defaults.
Both canonical and legacy code paths consume one shared typed disposition and preserve all repository and ref mutation effects without divergent logic.
Production workflows must use only canonical 0/1/2 routes with no numeric whitelist, and paused state must still skip commit-and-push behavior.
Existing deployment, systemd, Jenkins, and script consumers of 3/4/75 exit codes must remain functional without modification or must be explicitly migrated and documented as compatibility-only.
